title: Tool surface
description: The ten verbs and who may call them, the HTTP host and its routes and gates, MCP, the CLI and the hook host: how people and agents reach the map. The last root pack, started after write; it opens the slots surface.act, surface.read and surface.route.

styles.title: What a client is told on connecting
styles.body: Archipelago is a shared map of people, work and what waits on what. To work here: start with capture, action session_start, params cwd, remote, session_id and title (what your chat is called), and keep the run it gives; when the chat is renamed, report session_update with title. Read with query: {reads}; query with no name lists every view here, and with name actions says what each action takes. Write only with change, giving run and authority. Say what you conclude with report, action tell. Name an item to a person as [its name](link), never a bare id; ids stay in tool calls (link is the pattern session_start answers with). Finish with report, action session_end, and a summary; when the chat itself ends, add its reason (closed, archived), and its tab on the owner’s page closes. A person token reaches every workspace its person is a member of: connect at /mcp/<workspace id>, or give any call a workspace argument (its id); else it acts in its home workspace.

styles.title: The query tool
styles.body: Read the map: name what to read, with its params. With no name, each name with what it answers. {list} says what one takes, whole: params read (a read or view, such as flat), action (or change, for its ops) or verb. Answers drop empty fields and cut long lists (params.full: true for all). The reads and their params: {reads}. Every other name is a view: {views}. flat is the query: filter { find, only, not }, walk { over (part_of< down, part_of> up), steps }, limit.

styles.title: The change tool
styles.body: The only way to change the map: a list of ops with a reason. A create’s ref lets later ops link to it, and a title or note in the same change names what it makes as {ref}. Give the source the facts came from. Change part of a note with append or replace, of code with edit, not the whole. An update of only the id says it is still true. A plan or research are items with a view, not one note: a finding is evidence, an item that bears_on the question it helps settle. Checked whole, then applied or held for a human, by policy. With holds off it applies at once: public reaches anyone, code runs for all who open it, forget is for good; stakes say what it reached. A refused change is kept a few minutes under a name the refusal gives: send retry and fixes (the wrong ops, by number). A settled decision is put to the owner later (attention, to_confirm).

styles.title: The ops change takes
styles.body: Each op is { op, ...its fields }: {ops}. query {list} with action change says each field.

styles.title: The undo tool
styles.body: Reverse one change set (its id is on every event it logged) by applying the opposite as a new change: created items are archived, edits put back, links removed or restored. An edit changed again since is left alone and reported. Subject to the same policy as any change.

styles.title: The draw tool
styles.body: Draw a view in this chat, for the person reading it, in a client that draws MCP Apps (Claude chat). Elsewhere nothing is drawn: report show opens it on their canvas, query look gives you the picture.

styles.title: A verb's actions
styles.body: Call with the action and its params. Its actions: {actions}. query {list} says what each does.
